part.text:
Cache expiry is in `oxidepy/cache.py:13` — `TTLCache.get_or_set`:

* `oxidepy/cache.py:16` captures `now = time.monotonic()`
* `oxidepy/cache.py:17` checks `if hit is not None and (now - hit[1]) < self.ttl_seconds:` — returns cached `hit[0]` only if elapsed time since insertion (`hit[1]`) is strictly less than `ttl_seconds`; otherwise recomputes via `producer()` and overwrites entry. Expiry is lazy (checked only on `get_or_set`, no background eviction).
